options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Plando Connections
options.doc:
Generic connection plando. Format is:
- entrance: Entrance Name
  exit: Exit Name
  direction: Direction
  percentage: 100
Direction must be one of entrance, exit, or both, and defaults to both if omitted.
Direction entrance means the entrance leads to the exit. Direction exit means the exit leads to the entrance.
If you do not have Decoupled enabled, you do not need the direction line, as it will only use both.
Percentage is an integer from 0 to 100 which determines whether that connection will be made. Defaults to 100 if omitted.
This option does nothing if Entrance Randomization is disabled.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Choose the goal for this run.
- Lord of Doors: Defeat the Lord of Doors. Removes the Rusty Belltower Key location.
- True Ending: Receive all 7 Ancient Tablets of Knowledge and go to the door in the Camp of the Free Crows
- Green Tablet: Open the door in Family Tomb by planting enough life seeds (determined by plant_pot_number). Removes the Green Tablet location. The amount of extra Life Seeds in the pool is controlled by extra_life_seeds.
- Any: any of the above goals are valid. Note: on minimal accessibility, not all goals may be possible. Both the Rusty Belltower Key and the Green Tablet locations are removed from randomization.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez le but pour cette course.
- Lord of Doors: Vaincre le Seigneur des Portes. Supprime l'emplacement de la clé de clochette Rusty.
- True Ending: Recevez les 7 tablettes anciennes de la connaissance et allez à la porte dans le camp des Crows libres
- Green Tablet: Ouvrez la porte dans le tombeau familial en plantant suffisamment de graines de vie (déterminées par plant pot number). Supprime l'emplacement de la tablette verte. La quantité de graines supplémentaires dans le bassin est contrôlée par extra life seeds.
- Any: tous les objectifs ci-dessus sont valides. Remarque : sur l'accessibilité minimale, tous les objectifs ne sont pas possibles. La clé du clocher Rusty et la tablette verte sont retirées de la randomisation.

options.name: Entrance Randomization
options.doc: Randomize entrances.

options.name: Start Day or Night
options.doc: Choose whether to start during the day or night. You must access the Rusty Belltower Bell to toggle the time of day.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez de commencer le jour ou la nuit. Vous devez accéder au Belltower Bell pour basculer l'heure de la journée.

options.name: Number of Planted Pots Required for Green Tablet
options.doc: Number of planted pots required for Green Tablet location.

options.name: Early Important Item
options.doc:
Choose whether one random important item will be placed early in the multiworld, early and in your world, or to allow the items to be placed randomly.
If the random placement is chosen, generation is more likely to fail with smaller multiworlds.
Important items include non-boss doors, Hookshot, Bomb, and Fire, as these grant access to checks immediately.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez si un élément important aléatoire sera placé tôt dans le multimonde, tôt et dans votre monde, ou pour permettre que les éléments soient placés au hasard.
Si le placement aléatoire est choisi, la génération est plus susceptible d'échouer avec de plus petits multimondes.
Les articles importants comprennent les portes non-boss, Hookshot, Bomb et Fire, car ceux-ci donnent accès immédiatement aux vérifications.

options.name: Gate Rolls Glitch
options.doc:
Puts rolling through certain "gates" in logic.
- Estate entrance to Crypt through metal gate
- Mushroom Dungeon Lobby to Overgrown Ruins through vines
- Mushroom Dungeon Ancient Door to Lobby through a metal gate and a cobweb

options.name: Bomb Bell Glitch
options.doc: Puts bombing the Rusty Belltower's bell from a railing to toggle Day/Night in logic. Also, known as "Early Night".

options.name: Offscreen Targeting Tricks
options.doc:
Puts three tricks in which you must target an enemy or switch from offscreen in logic.
- Open the switch between Lost Cemetery and Stranded Sailor caves using an Arrow through a fire source instead of Fire
- Open a bomb wall in Overgrown Ruins lower by hitting an offscreen bomb flower with an arrow
- Open the path backwards from Flooded Fortress Frog King Statue back to the entrance by hitting a switch offscreen

options.name: Geometry Exploits
options.doc:
Puts a series of exploits where you roll on unintended surfaces in logic.
- Rolling across the walls near the ladder immediately outside the exit from Lost Cemetery to Stranded Sailor Caves to navigate around the switch on the Lost Cemetery side
- Rolling behind the grate in Castle Lockstone East Upper down to East
- Rolling onto the wall from the upper right platform in Lockstone East Upper after making it go up to get into East Upper Keyed Door without the lever
- When coming from the Old Watchtowers Barb Elevator, the lever to Ice Skating Start can be skipped by hooking over the gate from the ledge around the top of the elevator
- In Overgrown Ruins, access the Soul Orb in Lower that requires Hookshot by rolling onto the wall above and falling down. Standalone randomizer notes that this roll may require Haste (rolling stat) >=2.
- In Overgrown Ruins, access the Soul Orb in the Lord of Doors Hookshot arena by ???. Standalone randomizer is missing a description of this one, but best guess it is the same as the above.

options.name: Roll Buffers
options.doc:
Puts roll buffers in logic, where you roll in mid-air after a heavy attack. Three of these tricks can be performed with any weapon but the Thunder Hammer. Two are only doable with the Rogue Daggers. This option will cause all weapons besides the Thudner Hammer to be marked as progression.
- Hall of Doors - Surveillance Device: Heavy to the right and roll down-right from behind the bin near the Discarded Umbrella check
- Hall of Doors - Bomb Secret Soul Orb: Same as above
- Hall of Doors - Hookshot Secret Soul Orb: Up-right heavy and roll from above the Lord of Doors poster by the staircase near the Bomb Avarice Chest (Rogue Daggers only)
- Hall of Doors - Modern Door Scale Model: Same as above (Rogue Daggers only)
- Castle Lockstone - West Locked Crow: Heavy out of the ledge above the gate then immediately roll back

options.name: Adjust Extra Life Seeds
options.doc:
Add extra life seeds or remove extra life seeds from the item pool, which are interchanged with Soul Orb items. Counted from the 50 vanilla Life Seeds, regardless of plant_pot_number.

Every Life Seed counts in logic. Life Seeds skip progression balancing, so they aren't pulled into early spheres of the multiworld.

When removing life seeds (using a negative number), the number left in the pool will be at minimum the number required by plant_pot_number.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoutez des graines de vie supplémentaires ou retirez des graines de vie supplémentaires de la piscine de l'article, qui sont échangées avec des articles Soul Orb. Retenu des 50 graines de vie de vanille, quel que soit le nombre de plants pot .

Chaque graine de vie compte dans la logique. Life Seeds saute l'équilibre de progression, de sorte qu'ils ne sont pas attirés dans les premières sphères du multimonde.

Lors de l'enlèvement des graines de vie (en utilisant un nombre négatif), le nombre laissé dans le pool sera au minimum le nombre requis par plant pot number.

options.name: Extra Magic Shards
options.doc: Add extra magic shards to the item pool, replacing Soul Orb items. Extra magic shards can allow your magic to go over the vanilla maximum of 6. Each extra pip of magic requires 4 shards.
options.doc_fr: Ajoutez des éclats magiques supplémentaires à la piscine de l'article, en remplaçant les articles Soul Orb. Des éclats magiques supplémentaires peuvent permettre à votre magie de dépasser le maximum de vanille de 6. Chaque pointe supplémentaire de magie nécessite 4 shards.

options.name: Extra Vitality Shards
options.doc: Add extra vitality shards to the item pool, replacing Soul Orb items. Extra vitality shards can allow your health to go over the vanilla maximum of 6. Each extra pip of health requires 4 shards.
options.doc_fr: Ajoutez des éclats de vitalité supplémentaires au pool d'articles, en remplaçant les articles Soul Orb. Les éclats de vitalité supplémentaire peuvent permettre à votre santé de dépasser le maximum de la vanille de 6. Chaque pointe supplémentaire de santé nécessite 4 shards.

options.name: Remove Spell Upgrades
options.doc: Remove the spell upgrades from the pool, such that there is only 1 Fire, 1 Bomb, and 1 Hookshot in the pool (and no upgrade for Arrow).

options.name: Unrandomized Pools
options.doc:
Allows sets of location-item pairs (pools) to be removed from randomization. Valid keys are:
- Spell
- Weapon
- Giant Soul
- Shrine
- Shiny Thing
- Life Seed
- Soul Orb
- Tablet
- Lever
- Door
- Lost Crow

Keys must be randomized because their vanilla locations can cause a softlock in rando.

If you remove Weapons from randomization, your starting weapon will be forced to be the Reaper's Sword (default weapon).
If you remove Shiny Things from randomization, Rusty Belltower Key will still be added to the pool for day/night access.
If you remove Doors from randomization, you start with the Castle Lockstone and Camp of the Free Crows doors, since generation rarely succeeds otherwise.
If you remove Soul Orbs together with so many other pools that fewer than 70 locations stay randomized, Soul Orbs will be randomized anyway, since generation is not reliable without them.
If you combine this option with plando not from pool, you are very likely to encounter generation errors.
The fewer pools randomized, the more likely you are to encounter generation errors.
options.doc_fr:
Permet de retirer de la randomisation des ensembles de paires d'éléments de localisation (pools). Les clés valides sont :
- Expulsion
- Arme
- Âme géante
- Temple
- Chose brillante
- Semences vivantes
- Orbe d'âme
- Comprimé
- Levier
- Porte
- Crow perdu

Les clés doivent être randomisées parce que leurs emplacements de vanille peuvent causer un softlock dans rando.

Si vous retirez des armes de la randomisation, votre arme de départ sera forcée d'être l'épée de Reaper (arme par défaut).
Si vous supprimez Shiny Things de la randomisation, Rusty Belltower Key sera toujours ajouté à la piscine pour un accès jour/nuit.
Si vous retirez des portes de la randomisation, vous commencez par les portes Castle Lockstone et Camp of the Free Crows, puisque la génération réussit rarement autrement.
Si vous supprimez Soul Orbs avec tant d'autres piscines que moins de 70 emplacements restent randomisés, Soul Orbs sera randomisé de toute façon, puisque la génération n'est pas fiable sans eux.
Si vous combinez cette option avec plando pas de pool, vous êtes très susceptible de rencontrer des erreurs de génération.
Moins les bassins sont aléatoires, plus vous risquez de rencontrer des erreurs de génération.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc:
The probability for each filler item (including unique filler) to be replaced with a trap item.
The exact number of trap items will still be somewhat random, so you can't know
if you've seen the 'last trap' in your world without checking the spoiler log.
If you don't want any traps, set this to 0.
options.doc_fr:
La probabilité pour chaque élément de remplissage (y compris le remplissage unique) d'être remplacé par un élément de piège.
Le nombre exact d'éléments de piège sera encore un peu aléatoire, donc vous ne pouvez pas savoir si vous avez vu le « dernier piège » dans votre monde sans vérifier le journal des spoilers.
Si vous ne voulez pas de pièges, mettez ceci à 0.

options.name: Trap Type Weights
options.doc:
When a filler item is replaced with a trap, these weights determine the
odds for each trap type to be selected.
If you don't want a specific trap type, set its weight to 0.
Setting all weights to 0 is the same as setting trap_chance to 0.

options.name: Shop Upgrades
options.doc:
Turn the 20 stat upgrades sold by the Banker (5 each of Strength, Dexterity, Haste and Magic) into checks.
Buying an upgrade sends a check instead of raising your stat; your stats rise when you receive the matching
"Progressive Strength/Dexterity/Haste/Magic" items.
Logic expects the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th upgrade of a stat once you can reach 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8 areas with
enemies to earn souls in (the Hall of Doors has none). Each stat's prices always rise from one upgrade to the next. The Banker in the Hall of Doors and in the Camp of the Free Crows share the same stock.

options.name: Shop Prices
options.doc:
How much each shop upgrade costs when Shop Upgrades is on.
- Vanilla: 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1500 souls for the 1st to 5th purchase of each stat.
- Shuffled: the 20 vanilla prices are shuffled between the stats (each stat still gets cheaper upgrades first).
- Random Range: every upgrade costs a random amount between Shop Price Minimum and Shop Price Maximum, sorted so each stat gets more expensive.

options.name: Shop Hints
options.doc:
When Shop Upgrades is on, looking at a stat in the shop shows the item its next upgrade holds and sends a hint
for it, so it shows up in your hint list and in the tracker (and tells the player it belongs to).

options.name: Shop Price Minimum
options.doc: Lowest price of a shop upgrade when Shop Prices is Random Range.

options.name: Shop Price Maximum
options.doc: Highest price of a shop upgrade when Shop Prices is Random Range. If lower than the minimum, the two are swapped.

options.name: Extra Stat Upgrades
options.doc:
Add this many extra Progressive Strength/Dexterity/Haste/Magic items (random stats) on top of the normal ones,
replacing Soul Orb filler. Stats can go past the vanilla maximum of 5 this way. Works with or without Shop Upgrades.
options.doc_fr: Ajoutez ces nombreux éléments supplémentaires Progressive Strength/Dextérité/Haste/Magic (statistiques aléatoires) en plus des éléments normaux, en remplaçant le remplissage Soul Orb. Les statistiques peuvent dépasser le maximum de vanille de 5 de cette façon. Fonctionne avec ou sans Améliorations Shop.

options.name: Planting Checks
options.doc:
Number of checks for planting Life Seeds in pots. Each check is sent once you have planted
a multiple of Seeds Per Planting Check (e.g. 10 checks with 5 seeds each: checks at 5, 10, ..., 50 seeds planted).
0 turns planting checks off. The number is lowered automatically if there aren't enough Life Seeds in the pool.

options.name: Seeds Per Planting Check
options.doc: How many Life Seeds you have to plant for each planting check.

options.name: Starting Weapon
options.doc: Choose which weapon you would like to start with. The others will be shuffled into the itempool as useful items. Note: Umbrella is a much worse weapon than the other 4, choose it at your own risk.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez l'arme avec laquelle vous voulez commencer. Les autres seront mélangés dans le pool d'articles en tant qu'éléments utiles. Remarque : Le parapluie est une arme bien pire que les autres 4, choisissez-le à vos risques et périls.

options.name: Soul Multiplier
options.doc: Multilpy the amount of souls you receive, both from enemies and received Soul Orbs. Must be an integer.

options.name: Starting Souls
options.doc: Amount of souls to start the game with. Each full upgrade of a stat costs 4,300 souls.
options.doc_fr: Quantité d'âmes pour commencer le jeu avec. Chaque mise à niveau complète d'une statistique coûte 4300 âmes.
